section_damage._doc: M10-T08 (D12.5, Q53): how a capital's sections take damage. reactor_overload: share of a reactor's points it takes after it shuts down before it blows; pass_on: share of a hit on a lost section passed to the nearest live section; headless_fire_rate: rate of fire on last orders after the bridge is lost; power_stage_at and power_stage_level: below this share of its points a reactor gives this share of power; mount_reach_m: a hit this close to a live mount (or within its barrel's length) lands on it too.

mount_hit_points._doc: M10-T08 (Q53, docs/assets-capital.md 'Sections, mounts and blasts'): a mount's own hit points, by its weapon's kind (data/capitals/loadouts.json), else by the hardpoint's kind.

blasts._doc: M10-T09 (D12.6, Q18, Q53; docs/assets-capital.md 'Sections, mounts and blasts'): every explosion is a falloff blast, damage d0 x f(d) and push dv = impulse x f(d) x A / m (A the mean face area of the hull's box, capped at push_cap_mps), f(d) = (1 - (d/R)^2)^2 with d measured to the hull's nearest hit volume. sources: d0 (hull points at the centre), radius_m, impulse (N s/m^2) by source. sections: per blast class, [d0, radius_m] by explosive section kind and one impulse; a capital's death is the blast of the section that blew (its reactor's without one). classes: a capital class with no row of its own -> the row it takes; factions: a side whose capitals take a row of their own (the ancients: T04's placeholder). A pooled hull's death: hulls (asset id -> source) first, else small_craft_death for a hull the loadouts class as small craft, else by_role from the catalogue's role; cargo (asset id -> kind) scales it by cargo_scale (placeholders until the maintainer sets them). flash_j_per_d0: a blast's energy for the far flashes.
